main.description: Download an account's permissioned repo within a space as a STAR file, for full-state recovery. The archive's metadata is the repo's commit; each key/value pair is a record path ('{collection}/{rkey}') and the record's DRISL encoding, in strict lexicographic order of the path. Blobs are not included and are fetched separately via getBlob. Served by a repo host. Callable with either OAuth (for the authenticated user's own data) or a space credential (for syncing services). When called with a space credential, the caller must request a MAC with an Accept-Signature header (tag atproto-space-commit), and the response carries the archive commit's MAC in Signature-Input and Signature headers covering an Atproto-Space-Commit header.

repo.description: The DID of the account whose repo to download.

errors.name: InvalidSpaceMac
errors.description: The MAC requested in the Accept-Signature header is missing or invalid.
